categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies shared signaling utility primitive in src/util/btcsignals.h.
categories.rationale: Fixes a resource lifetime flaw in btcsignals that leads to shutdown deadlocks. Disconnected callbacks previously remained alive in memory indefinitely, which commit 8bd1cda004 notes kept bitcoin-node from exiting and hung GUI shutdown in multiprocess work (#10102).
